verdict.rationale: Glama Chat lets users upload their own PDFs, Word docs or text files and get AI-generated answers with exact page references, so AI output is grounded in user data inside the product. That is on-demand Q&A, not proactive insights or suggestions. Nothing shows AI analysis of in-product data such as Gateway call logs or usage. Missing for 10: proactive AI insights/suggestions, AI analysis of the user's Glama platform data (gateway logs, usage, servers), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Upload any PDF, Word doc, or text file. Get instant answers with exact page references.
Search across documents and chats. Save and tag important conversations.
